newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Louvre museum closed by strike.
newsitem.headline: France's Louvre museum closed by strike.

text.p: A strike by guards closed Paris' Louvre Museum for a third day in a row on Saturday, dismaying visitors planning to see the Mona Lisa and other masterpieces.
The guards, demanding extra days off for working the overnight shift, blockaded the glass and steel pyramid at the entrance of the museum in the heart of Paris.
"We're not taking the public hostage," unionist Charles Elie Nelson told TF1 television, saying that guards were demanding talks with management over their demands.
"It does not leave a good taste of France," one disgruntled American tourist said.
